At RAN4 meeting#109, we submitted a CR to clarify the active TCI state list update delay requirement in 38.133 [1]. We followed up with a new proposal of clarification at RAN4 meeting#110 [2], in which we detailed ambiguity/inaccuracy in the specification text. During the meeting, there was another proposal from [3]. In this contribution, we share our views on how to fix the issue based on the proposals on the table and comments received at RAN4 meeting#110.
